notes: Listed in NCRS 'C3 Rivet Identification' thread among common bracket-attaching rivets, but no size given in visible snippets; thread page returned 403. Round 3: Searched bare/GM corvette; only the AIM index itself. No size. Round 4: Zip lists 3829910 with nut plate 3825325 in its 63-67 rear exhaust panel nut plate kit ('aluminum assembly rivets'), no size next to the GM number. Corvette Central's similar kit says 3/16 x 5/8 flat aluminum rivet but cites no GM number, so not recorded.

sources.title: C3 Rivet Identification - NCRS Discussion Boards
sources.quote: I am sure there are more but these appear to be most of the most common ones used for attaching brackests to the body.

sources.title: 1963-1967 Corvette Rear Exhaust Panel Nut Plates w/Mount Rivets (GM Part 3825325)
sources.quote: OE GM PART #: 3825325, 3829910 ... includes (8) black zinc steel nut plates and (16) aluminum assembly rivets
